# Bobosshots — Terzea Bogdan, Fotograf Profesionist Sibiu

> Photography portfolio of Terzea Bogdan (brand: Bobosshots), a professional photographer
> based in Sibiu, Romania. Specialties: artistic portraits, events (weddings, baptisms,
> concerts, corporate), product & real-estate photography, travel photography and videography.
> Transparent pricing in RON. Romanian site with full English toggle. Available throughout
> Romania for special events.

Key facts:

- Photographer: Terzea Bogdan
- Location: Sibiu, Romania (45.7983, 24.1256)
- Contact: Instagram DM preferred (https://instagram.com/bobosshots), phone +40 748 144 371, email contact@bobosshots.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00, Sat 10:00–16:00, Sun closed (Europe/Bucharest)
- Last updated: 2026-06-11
